summary:
• Android Developer with 8+ years of experience in designing and developing scalable mobile applications
using Java and Kotlin.
• Proficient in Android SDK, Jetpack components, and MVVM architecture, ensuring robust, maintainable,
and high-performing applications.
• Skilled in integrating third-party APIs, Bluetooth, Aadhaar services, and biometric authentication, delivering
secure and feature-rich mobile solutions.
• Hands-on expertise in Room Database, Retrofit, Coroutines Flow, Dagger, Hilt, and Jetpack Compose, with
a strong focus on clean code and performance optimization.
• Proven track record of delivering user-friendly, multilingual, and client-centric apps across domains such as
e-commerce, mobility, and government services.

bullets: Designed and developed an Android application using Java, enabling drivers to manage leave, track earnings, and view the status of company-lent assets.
Implemented features for driver onboarding and deboarding under a franchise model, ensuring seamless management of driver hierarchies within the app.
Delivered a bilingual interface (Hindi/English) to improve accessibility and usability for a diverse driver base.
Developed a Bluetooth-based Android application using Java for testing batteries with SBJT, enabling accurate device communication and data handling.
Implemented core functionalities such as engineer attendance marking, leave application management, and complaint creation, improving workflow efficiency.
Enhanced app stability and performance in the Android ecosystem, ensuring a smooth and reliable user experience across devices.
Developed an Android application using Java and Kotlin, like Livserv but with user-based customization to meet client-specific requirements.
Implemented features for product warranty registration, enabling clients to easily register and manage product warranties through the app.
Enhanced UI/UX and optimized performance within the Android ecosystem, ensuring seamless client engagement and usability.
Developed an Android application using Java to prevent voter duplication by capturing and verifying voter data with secure Aadhaar integration.
Implemented biometric fingerprint capture and comparison features to detect and prevent fraudulent or duplicate voting.
Optimized data handling and app performance in the Android ecosystem, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and secure voter verification.
Designed and developed an e-commerce Android application using Java for selling organic products, integrating secure product browsing and checkout features.
Implemented interactive modules such as Q&A, comments, and an articles section, enhancing customer engagement and knowledge sharing.
Optimized app performance and UI within the Android ecosystem, ensuring a smooth and user-friendly shopping experience.

entries.degree: B.Tech/B.E. in Computers from Indian Institute of Technology, Guwahati 2013
